name: search_trips
description: Search the trip catalog by type, price ceiling and text, cheapest first, ties by package id.

trip_type.description: Exact trip type, for example ``City Breaks``.

max_price_per_person.description: Highest price per traveler to include.

limit.description: Number of trips to return, clamped to 1 through 20.

text.description: Words to look for in a trip's name, description, operator, destination or trip type. The Phase 1 and 2 fallback when no trip type matched.

name: compare_packages
description: Return aligned comparison rows for up to 4 trip packages.

name: price_range
description: Return the price range (low / average / high) for a destination.

destination.description: city or region string (matched ILIKE against the destination or region columns).

name: region_inventory
description: Return how many distinct trip packages we sell in a region, with aggregate availability across all duration options.

name: currency_convert
description: Convert an amount between supported currencies using indicative rates.

name: hybrid_trip_search
description: Search trip packages by meaning and by words, then rerank them.

query.description: natural-language trip request. Name the destination and the qualities wanted. A price ceiling in the query ("under $2,500") is applied, and sold-out packages are left out. At most 500 characters.
